description: A file two groups name, under Jest 30.5.2 (T8.11, `coverage.thresholdGrouping`): `src/deep/partial.ts` is under the path group `./src/deep/` (which it meets) and under the glob group `./src/**/*.ts` (which it misses on functions), and Jest reports the glob group's miss: a file counts for every group that names it, and only the files no group named go to `global`. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-thresholds.test.ts`.
